notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an installed OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows foundation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 planning, event-driven WASAPI capture, sample decode/reframing, CaptureRuntime reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery, bounded virtual-mic staging/output, Rust/C++ transport ABI, aligned Interlocked cursor publication, deterministic shared-region geometry, real user-mode section mapping and a WDK-buildable driver path. Driver-owned CONNECT v2 replaced the unsafe caller-supplied-section assumption in merge 3953069f468c46d744f30625b3696e5b12f03a77. Protocol v2 guarded ring consumption merged as 9c57207482bdc20ca5dc70a06cbb43c0cfa86741. PortCls/WaveRT descriptors merged as da1b0543bcbfe63ff6a342690cab3b250057bbe2 and the fail-closed PortCls lifecycle/WaveRT stream contract merged as 78ef04bf86bf02b25b9da25ef401dc84f73f0f2b. The unsupported WDF control-device experiment was superseded after Microsoft KMDF miniport guidance; the raw WDM scaffold merged as e31e40c0a78dcdf99396ea8a0bf3648691416b35. Secure raw WDM CONNECT/DISCONNECT/QUERY_STATUS then merged as 6c395ef7cbd7afc5caa3daac506dee16073335fe after AI Native run 34713202688 and Windows run 34713202712 passed. The next live-driver slice initially failed Windows run 34713657493 because WdfDriverMiniportUnload was not declared; adding the required wdfminiport.h include fixed the build. AI Native Quality Gates run 34713869004 and Windows Audio Validation run 34713869035 then both passed on implementation head 228a3edef05ef1598dec8f13af282950d2479764. PR #25 merged the verified PortCls-primary live DriverEntry as 14fd4c55ae6ad44d1e43af3ea574e66427f7551e. Live initialization now uses WDF_NO_EVENT_CALLBACK plus WdfDriverInitNoDispatchOverride, WdfDriverCreate, PcInitializeAdapterDriver, post-PortCls installation of the raw WDM CREATE/CLOSE/CLEANUP and DEVICE_CONTROL multiplexers, delayed raw-control publication until the final dispatch table is active, PcDispatchIrp forwarding for every non-control device, and bounded raw-control -> PortCls -> WDF miniport unload/failure cleanup. StartDevice still deliberately returns STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED, so no endpoint or miniport-registration claim is made. The next valid WU-002 action is to implement/register the minimal topology and WaveRT capture miniports, create the concrete IMiniportWaveRT stream, bind stream scheduling to ConsumeOneRingFrame plus the verified position/notification contract, then proceed to INF/test-sign installation, endpoint enumeration, runtime DeviceIoControl, calling-app routing and controlled-hardware evidence. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates. Multi-agent execution is still in degraded single-runtime mode because config/ai/agent-catalog.json has no verified attachable agents and config/coordination/supervisor-state.json has no live Supervisor. The owner-requested 11-worker pool must not be represented as active until real identities are attached and leased through the canonical coordination protocol; dependency-ready WU-level parallelism currently exists for WU-002, WU-014 and WU-016 while later work remains gated by the execution-plan dependency graph.
